name: albok
description: Desktop class companion: follow imported book sections in class and keep notes by subject.

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web -c blue,magenta "npm run backend" "npm --prefix frontend run web"
scripts.desktop:dev: concurrently -k -n web,desktop -c magenta,green "npm --prefix frontend run dev" "wait-on http-get://localhost:8081 && npm --prefix desktop run dev"
scripts.desktop: npm run build:web && npm --prefix desktop start
scripts.test: node scripts/backend.mjs test && npm --prefix frontend run typecheck
scripts.dist:win: npm run build:web && npm run build:backend && npm --prefix desktop run dist:win
